new.n: Wabeno bank loot, 1921 search ground 7 mi N of Wabeno (empty cache dug up)
new.pl: Dense woods about seven miles north of Wabeno (GNIS Wabeno offset 7 mi N); the cache spot was not mapped.
new.v: $32,000 in cash and securities (about $8,000 never recovered)
new.st: Ten days after the 16 Jul 1921 Wabeno State Bank robbery, one suspect led officers to a cache about seven miles north of Wabeno in dense woods, marked by a white handkerchief tied to a tree. The earth was freshly turned and the loot gone; two men wanted in the case had just obtained blueberry-picking permits. On 30 Jul about 300 searchers beat the woods some seven miles out for a fallen-tree cache. By July 1922 all but about $8,000 had been recovered. This is the 1921 search ground; the 1922 search west of Athelstane has its own pin.
new.t: Search ground, not a spot: the dug-up cache was empty and the money was probably moved. Much of this country is county and national forest: follow forest rules; detecting may need a permit.
pinev: 'About seven miles north of Wabeno' only; pin is GNIS Wabeno moved 7 mi N.
new.tovw: Lead grade C (court/probate + treasure threads): 1921 search ground of the Wabeno bank loot

cr-wabeno-bank-loot-1921.st: A second pin marks the 1921 search ground about 7 mi N of Wabeno.
